description: Source code for handling delete requests in a USP (User Services Platform) agent, including processing delete messages, managing delete responses, and handling object deletion logic with support for partial and full delete operations.

classes.name: del_expr_info_t
classes.description: Structure representing resolved delete expression info, including path, index, object count, and error details.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_HandleDelete
methods.description: Main handler for processing incoming delete messages, resolving object paths, and generating responses.

methods.name: ProcessDel_AllowPartialTrue
methods.description: Processes delete requests with allow_partial=true, deleting objects individually and collecting results.

methods.name: ProcessDel_AllowPartialFalse
methods.description: Processes delete requests with allow_partial=false, attempting atomic deletion or failing.

methods.name: CreateFullDeleteResp
methods.description: Creates a detailed delete response with success and failure info for each requested path.

methods.name: CreateBasicDeleteResp
methods.description: Creates an empty delete response message.

methods.name: AddDeleteResp_OperSuccess
methods.description: Adds a successful delete operation result to the response.

methods.name: AddOperSuccess_AffectedPath
methods.description: Adds an affected object path to a success result.

methods.name: AddOperSuccess_UnaffectedPathError
methods.description: Adds an error for objects that failed to delete.

methods.name: AddDeleteResp_OperFailure
methods.description: Adds a failure result for a delete operation.

methods.name: DeleteAllInstancesProvidedByGroupId
methods.description: Deletes all objects in a group via multi-delete or individual delete, ensuring atomicity if supported.
